ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear recording with a pleasant mids boost captures a tight Playing > Terrapin > Playing run that showcases the band listening to each other.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this source as the best‑sounding version they've heard, noting its open midrange and reduced audience noise. The performance is highlighted by a seamless Playing > Terrapin > Playing sequence, with the band tightly locked in. Overall the audio quality and musical interplay are both rated highly.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single review is available; it gives 4 stars and emphasizes excellent sound quality plus a strong performance, leading to an overall rating of 4.0.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear, open mids with less audience noise than comparable sources; crisp and detailed on headphones/DAC.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transition from Playing into Terrapin and back, demonstrating tight group listening.
